tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must be a company registered in India under companies Act/Limited Liability partnership act and should have been in operation for a period of at least 5 years as on bid date. (Consortium and joint ventures formed for the purpose of this project are not eligible to bid for this project. Trusts and societies are also not eligible to bid for this project)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Partnership

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully executed Supply /renewal of AMC for Servers of minimum value of one order of Rs.1.60 crore or 2 orders of Rs.80 lakhs each or 3 orders of Rs.55 lakhs each during last 7 years as on bid submission date for any State Data Center/Data Center of PSUs/Enterprises.
Bidder should have valid ISO 9001 and 27001 OR 20000.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the valid ISO certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The annual turnover of the Bidder during each of the last 3 financial years (2022-23 2023-24 and 2024-25) shall not be less than Rs.3.20 Cr (Three Crores Twenty Lakhs)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have a positive net worth for the last 3 financial Years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
